## ⚠️ Update before you read the options — **option C is no longer a proposal, it is shipped and measured**

`domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-18T18:20Z. This card was filed at 2026-09-18T18:06:21Z with option C described as something nobody had implemented or ablated, and that is listed in its own confidence gaps. ⭐ **That gap closed 13 minutes later**, in PR objectui#9926's second round. The options below are restated against what is now on the branch, ⛔ not against what was true when the card was written.

### What changed

The delivering dev widened the pin exactly as option C describes: the four surviving statements in `complex.ts` are now held to a **recorded clause roster** derived from the tree, and the pin asserts the clauses all four share. Its own ablations, on head `fe14b7ddf5ebfdb2ddf5dd710bf2a46065aab959`:

| ablation | what it models | result |
|---|---|---|
| **C1** — a numbered clause added to the `ChatbotSchema` statement **only** | the escape this card was filed about | ⛔ **1 failed / 17 passed — now RED.** The roster assertion names the site and prints the extra clause |
| **C2** — the **same** clause, worded with no numbering, past every marker the roster carries | a genuinely novel clause | ⚠️ **18 passed / 18 — still silent** |
| head, unmodified | — | 18 / 18 |
| reverse (`mobile.ts` restored to its base blob) | the original two un-amended sites | 6 failed / 12 passed, naming both |

Every leg restored under a trap and verified by **blob-hash equality plus an empty `git diff HEAD`**, ⛔ never by an exit code.

### What that does to the four axes

- **③ 防 AI 犯错** — this is where it moves. The card said A and C were level because both make a miss loud. C is now **measured** loud for every clause the roster names, and **measured silent** for one worded past all of them. ⇒ C is no longer level with A: it is ⭐ better than the card claimed for the realistic case (an amendment reusing the rule's own vocabulary) and ⛔ honestly worse for the novel case.
- **① 长远合理性** — unchanged. C still leaves four statements in parallel; it caps the drift instead of removing it. A is still the only option that makes the next amendment a one-site edit.
- **② 实际业务拉动 / ④ 创业阶段不扩散** — unchanged, and both still favour C: ⛔ zero published `.d.ts` bytes move.

### The recommendation stands, and is now measured rather than argued

**C**, with A as the fallback if you want the class closed structurally. ⛔ What did **not** change, and this seat will not soften it: C2 is a real hole. C trades a one-site edit for a four-site edit that a gate supervises **for named clauses only**. If that residual is unacceptable, the answer is A, and the card's cost for A — a declarations reader pays a jump, measured — is unchanged.

⚠️ The delivering dev reached the same conclusion independently and said the argument for B/C is **stronger** than at review time rather than weaker; ⛔ this seat is not treating its agreement as confirmation, because both readings come from the same ablation run.

### One correction to this card's own text

The confidence gap that reads 「② ⛔ **not measured** — the cost of widening the pin (option C), which nobody has implemented or ablated」 is now **false**. It has been implemented and ablated, by the measurements above. ⛔ The other two gaps stand: no named external consumer has been checked, and the ablation numbers are still the dev's and the reviewer's readings rather than this seat's own re-run.

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Thread re-read to its last comment (5734333950) in the act that wrote this.

## Why this card qualifies for class-1

1. **It is inside the charter's named non-escalation class, so the direction is PM discretion, not a maintainer question.** 「四类记账事同属不升级类,恒以无产品可见行为变化为界:…纯文档措辞更正(无契约声明改动);既有门禁内部参数与盲区修复(加强,非削弱,非新增)」. Option C is exactly a pin strengthened to cover a measured blind spot (ablation C: a third prong added at one site passed 12/12); option A is a JSDoc restatement-to-citation edit that moves published `.d.ts` bytes for no behaviour change. Neither touches a contract declaration.
2. **Loud, and one revert.** C is measured on the branch (PR objectui#9926 head fe14b7dd, comment 5734333950): a numbered clause added at one site now fails 1/18; the residual (a novel clause worded past every roster marker) is disclosed. Reverting is one test file.
3. **No floor moves.** No security, no published semantics, no capability trade-off, no gate weakened.

## Ruling — **C** (the widened pin stands; the four statements stay inline)

The roster pin shipped in PR objectui#9926's second round is the answer; the four `complex.ts` JSDoc statements are ⛔ not converted to citations (A refused: it moves published `.d.ts` bytes and costs every declarations reader a jump, to remove a drift the pin now catches). B (leave them unguarded) is superseded by C already being on the branch.

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① C caps the drift where it lives, A removes it at the price of a published-bytes change — under 「创业阶段不扩散」 C; ② the cost paid twice by this project was a silent miss, and C makes it loud; ③ A and C are both loud, C is measured; ④ zero published bytes move.

`Prior rulings read:` the card's own line stands (ADR-0061 D2 / ADR-0130 D8 are keyword coincidences; no accepted decision governs duplicated normative JSDoc).

## Execution, same stroke

`needs-user-decision` off and the card closed `completed` — its deliverable rides PR objectui#9926 (card objectui#9684, `pm:dispatched`), which the `domain:ui` seat lands through the ordinary at-tier route; nothing else is owed here.
